narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I added all four Junes, so June's rainfall is three thousand four hundred millimetres.
<bookmark mark='tower'/>That tower holds the rain of four Junes together, far more than any one June.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The total still has to be shared equally among the four years.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Add the same month over all the years, then divide by the number of years.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Four Julys brought five hundred and twenty, then five hundred and eighty. Then came six hundred and ten, and four hundred and fifty. Find July's average.
